name: Interactive Brokers
tagline: Institutional-grade brokerage API for trading, market data, and account management
description: Interactive Brokers (IBKR) provides multi-asset trading APIs used by algo traders, fintech apps, and institutions to place orders, stream market data, manage portfolios, and automate brokerage workflows across stocks, options, futures, forex, and more.

auth.details: Local Client Portal Gateway uses browser login (username/password + 2FA) to establish a session; requests go to the local Gateway after authentication. Separate OAuth 2.0 applies to remote Client Portal Web API for third-party apps. Account required.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No standalone free API plan; access requires an eligible IBKR brokerage account (typically IBKR Pro). No separate API SaaS fee; market data and commissions billed per IBKR schedule.
pricing.paid_plans: No separate API SaaS fee; brokerage commissions + optional market data subscriptions apply. Access requires an opened IBKR account.

rate_limits: Client Portal Web API: ~10 requests/second global pacing; many endpoints have stricter limits (e.g. GET /portfolio/accounts often 1 req/5s). Exact limits vary by endpoint in IBKR docs.
use_cases: list brokerage accounts for a logged-in IBKR session
place and cancel stock or options orders programmatically
stream or poll real-time quotes and historical bars
fetch portfolio positions and account P&L
automate multi-asset trading workflows across stocks, futures, and FX
